title: •Daultay Dofine
caption: •Daultay Dofine (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. Blockade Flagship is immune to attrition < 9. While piloting Blockade Flagship and your {set:theed} Admiral’s Order on table, Blockade Flagship may not be targeted by weapons or have its power reduced. Once per game, may ▲ Gunray or Haako.
lore: Neimoidian Trade Federation captain who gained his current position through political backstabbing and family connections. Not favored by Darth Sidious.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 4. Yellow DS pilot-power icon + '3.' at the start → {pilot:3}. Inline round orange emblem in 'your [icon] Admiral’s Order' = the THEED PALACE set symbol → {set:theed} (the PC's VB5 reissue reads 'your [Theed Palace] Admiral's Order'; the wiki stub calls it 'grabber' — wrong). ▲ as printed. Curly apostrophe in Admiral’s. Icon column: pilot (yellow DS helmet) only. Affiliation Republic (Coruscant grey frame with the lilac Republic disc top-left; wiki subtype Republic). Margin credits two lines each: left 'Original concept' / 'by Justin Stratton', right 'Michigan' / 'States 2005'. Lore matches the wiki. Copyright '© 2001 …' (Coruscant, SE-style) read off the scan. Base scan 350 px only. Modern: V19-D-daultaydofine.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 19 remake — same art/lore, different (V) text); VB5 -pre also exists, not downloaded. Theed-D-captaindaultaydofine.gif is a different card.
